title: Heating the enzyme source rather than the protein substrate
original_forecast: If the heated source crosses its declared denaturation threshold, its later proteolytic activity should remain lower after cooling. The comparison is about enzyme history, not heating gelatin itself.
original_limitations: Equal heat and cooling doses do not guarantee identical final temperatures if phase changes or losses occur; confirm thermometer readings. Gel setting and tenderness are outside the enzyme ledger.
